Re: 

ITGO Asphalt Re(  o.  v. Frescati Shipping Co .. No.  18-565 

Dear Mr.  Harris: 

I represent petitioners in the above-captioned case.  On behalf of petitioners and both 
respondents (Frescati Shipping Company, Ltd., et al., and the United States), I am writing to 
request an extension of time for filing the briefs in this case, as  follows: 

Petitioners'  Opening Brief: 

July 9, 2019 

Respondents' Briefs: 

September 10, 2019 

Petitioners'  Reply Brief: 

October 10, 2019 

All parties have agreed to this proposed schedule, which would allow the Court to hold 

oral argument during the  ovember 2019 sitting.  Please let me know if you need any additional 
information. 

Sincerely,
